messages:
kelly (support): Heads up — acme-app reporting 503s from hosted API /v1/generate since ~14:22 UTC. CS ticket #6789. Multiple customers affected, spike to ~12% error rate.

sre-bot: [INCIDENT CREATED] INC-2026-112 assigned to oncall. Priority: P1.

emma (oncall): Taking. Can someone paste the last 1m of runner logs for shared-gpu-1 pool?

kelly (support): Pasted partial logs from the customer-facing proxy (sanitized):
```
2026-03-18T14:21:48Z ERROR upstream: container exited: signal 11
2026-03-18T14:21:48Z WARN runner: restarting container id=abc123
2026-03-18T14:21:48Z ERROR inference: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. attempted=1048576 used=1048000
2026-03-18T14:21:49Z ERROR k8s: OOMKilled pod/p-xyz node=n1-typeA
```

emma (oncall): those look like GPU OOM -> segfault/panic then container restart. I'm sshing into one affected node to grab fuller logs.

raj (eng-runtime): Noted. We shipped the allocator cap change yesterday — could be regressing under longstream workloads. Any pattern on request size / context length?

kelly (support): Customer said a handful of requests had 50k token contexts (embedding+long prompt) and many were streaming toolcalls.

emma (oncall): repro attempt: ran a short load test against shared-gpu-1 hitting long-context streaming (replicated 50k token payloads). After ~2 minutes saw memory creep then same stack: `cudaFree(): invalid device pointer` followed by segfault and container restart.

ops-runner: grabbed dmesg + pod logs, snippet: ```
Mar 18 14:22:00 n1 kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 12345 (infer-runner) total-vm:1200000kB anon-rss:900000kB
infer-runner[stderr]: *** SIGSEGV (segmentation fault) at 0x7fffbadcode ***
```

raj (eng-runtime): OK — allocator cap looks like it's not enforcing max for KV cache during streaming. Two immediate mitigations: 1) apply a soft cap on per-request KV growth, 2) route heavy long-context customers to a dedicated pool. I'll prepare a hotfix build to clamp prefetch.

tori (platform): In the short term I can add a routing rule for acme-app -> dedicated-gpu-2 (isolated pool) and throttle per-request tokens at the gateway. Want that now?

kelly (support): Please do — customer is on the phone and asking for immediate mitigation.

emma (oncall): Implemented gateway limit header: `x-max-context-tokens: 8192` for acme-app and added routing override to dedicated-gpu-2. Pushing now.

sre-bot: [CHANGE APPLIED] routing override + header injection for customer acme-app — actioned by tori.

luis (acme-cs): Confirming — errors dropped to near 0% within 3 minutes. Thanks. We'll keep load steady for 10m and report back.

emma (oncall): Monitoring metrics: shared-gpu-1 OOM restarts reduced; dedicated-gpu-2 handling acme traffic fine. Keeping this thread for postmortem notes.

raj (eng-runtime): I'll cut a hotfix to enforce KV cache max and add unit/regression test for longstream memory growth. Target: revert allocator cap change or patch by EOD.

kelly (support): CS to request SLA credit and log timeline for the customer while you follow up on hotfix.

ops-runner: Collected heap/profile dump and nvml metrics from the affected node — uploading to S3: https://s3.redwood-internal/incident/INC-2026-112/profiles (internal).

emma (oncall): Ownership: raj will own remediation; emma will run follow-on monitoring and verify rollout; tori will leave routing override until fix lands.

raj (eng-runtime): Patch posted, rolling to staging now. Patch adds: `kv_cache.max_bytes = min(global_cap, per_request_cap)` + backpressure when exceeded.

kelly (support): Customer follow-up scheduled. luis — sorry for the impact, we applied a routing and token cap to restore service. Will update once fix is validated.

luis (acme-cs): Appreciate the quick response. Please put the postmortem and repro steps in the ticket.

emma (oncall): Will do. Quick action items captured: [1] hotfix + tests (raj), [2] analyze allocator change for regression (raj), [3] postmortem + customer timeline (kelly), [4] keep routing override until confirmed (tori).

sre-bot: [INCIDENT RESOLVED?] error rate back to baseline. Marking as monitoring.

kelly (support): Closing CS urgent thread, leaving for postmortem. :thumbsup:
